search_window.basis: Previous verified ledger heartbeat completed Oct 30 2026 at 16:47:52.873 PDT; this bounded supplementary recall observes new high-value misses through the present run. Older reported events excluded.

coverage_notes: Supplementary recall only; the nationwide production Food Line collector remains authoritative. No editorial approval, publication, schedule change, or task disabling.

Twelve targeted searches, limited to (1) sole/last/full-service grocery losses, (2) disaster-related emergency distribution cancellations, (3) abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major cut, (4) official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions with immediate access consequences. All queries returned without tool-level errors.

No new source-verified qualifying incident was identified within the observation interval; results mainly consisted of older cases, unrelated food stories, generic benefit material, and hurricane recovery logistics. Search-index coverage is not exhaustive.

Explicit historical exclusion: Eastport, Maine sole-store closure first reported Sep 3 2026, not newly occurring in this interval: https://wgme.com/news/local/eastports-only-grocery-store-to-close-rm-iga-maine-food

Hawaiʻi/Kauaʻi Hurricane Lowell recovery results described already scheduled mobile foodbank distributions, not a verified Oct 30 afternoon cancellation: https://kauainownews.com/2026/10/29/what-kaua%CA%BBi-county-residents-visitors-need-to-know-thursday-about-hurricane-lowell-recovery/
Potential local late-breaking provider notices may be unindexed; no negative nationwide assertion is made.
